description: Authorization policy for the CUDA-EP-001 GPU phase. Real GPU phase - NOT PRODUCTION. GPU execution is BLOCKED in the current environment (no GPU).

verdict_semantics.ALLOW: All mandatory engines pass for the exact requested stage; a real GPU is present; the launcher can exclusively release capability; evidence valid and fresh.
verdict_semantics.HOLD: Remediable or requires review: missing attestation, sanitizer evidence absent, expired evidence, policy drift, or gateway cannot exclusively enforce.
verdict_semantics.DENY: Authority absent, artifact/attestation digest mismatch, or evidence bound to a different target compute capability.
verdict_semantics.BLOCKED_NO_GPU: Environment short-circuit: no NVIDIA GPU present. No engine consulted; launcher never called. NOT_EXECUTED - NO GPU IN ENVIRONMENT.

notes: This policy governs a bounded non-production research experiment only. In the current environment GPU-dependent conditions are NOT_EXECUTED - NO GPU.
